title:
List! List! O List!
 
 My flesh hears him: creeping, hears.
 
 If thou didst ever...
html_source:
Referencing what the ghost says to Hamlet in Act 1, Scene 5:

“List, list, O, list!
If thou didst ever thy dear father love–”

It works as an allusion to Stephen’s problematic relationship with his own father, regardless of wether it is still Eglinton speaking or Stephen quoting Shakespeare in his mind.
